published: Lake 1.7 x 10^4 m2 before, fully drained; about 1.1-1.2 x 10^5 m3 of water (Cook 2018; Sattar 2022)
Peak about 620 m3/s at the lake, about 4,100 m3/s at the confluence 6.5 km down after entraining about 8.3 x 10^6 m3 of debris (Sattar 2022)
Front at 8.7 m/s past four seismometers 21-29 km along the river; 1,500-2,100 m3/s at Chaku (Cook 2018)
lake_note: Too small to measure: at the lake, Landsat's best autumn water index is 0.17-0.21, under the 0.25 cut-off, and Sentinel-2 Level-1C counts snow as water (about 0.075 km2 both before and after a lake of 0.017 km2 that drained). The published size is used.
